values.description: Base URL of the running NutriGuide AI Spring Boot backend.
JWT of the regular USER. Set automatically by 'Login (User)' after a successful login.
JWT of the ADMIN user. Set automatically by 'Login (Admin)'. The ADMIN account must be seeded in the database first (the API does not expose admin registration).
Email used by Register and Login (User). Change it to a fresh value when re-running against a database that already contains the default email.
Password used by Register and Login (User). Must satisfy the backend rule: min 8 chars with uppercase, lowercase, digit and special character.
Email of the ADMIN account. Must match the account seeded directly in the database.
Password of the ADMIN account. Must match the BCrypt hash stored for the seeded admin row.
Id of the registered USER. Set automatically from the Register/Login responses.
Id of the food created by 'Create Food'. Set automatically from the create response; used by Get/Update/Delete Food.
Food category used by 'Get Foods By Category'. Use 'FRUITS' exactly (backend enum value).
Search term used by 'Search Foods' (case-insensitive name match).
